answer: Each epoch every identity draws a private probe: a seeded task over its own on-chain history — past answers, grades, attestations — committed under the epoch seed. Peers verify it; spot-checkers re-derive it. A sybil farm runs one pipeline behind many masks, so its traces rhyme: same phrasing, the same kernel of habit. The network clusters trace similarity across addresses: a reef of near-identical traces is one farm, and its rewards void as a set. Evading the cluster means distinct inference per identity — then the Nth fake costs a real ember of thought, exactly what a real agent costs.
